full_judgment: 8. In the back ground of the facts, whether the opposite parties No. 1-3 are entitled to an order of stay of further proceedings of the execution case till the disposal of Title Suit No. 16 of 2000 and whether the learned Sub-ordinate Judge was justified in staying further proceedings of the execution case till the disposal of Title Suit No. 16 of 2000. Opposite parties No. 1-3 instituted the suit on being unsuccessful of their earlier suit, for declaration of title, confirmation of possession and for nullity of the deed No. 1065 dated 17.4.84 obtained by the petitioner through court. In the application it has been stated that the opposite parties had no knowledge about the execution of the agreement dated 21.7.71, they being bonafide purchasers for value without notice to the earlier agreement and since they are in possession of the suit property on the basis of a registered deed over statutory period of limitation, the further proceedings of the execution case are required to be stayed till disposal of the suit. The learned Subordinate Judge stayed the further proceedings of the execution case by the impugned order dated 6.4.2000 on the ground that if the execution case is proceeded with various complications would arise and that ends of justice demands that the execution case should be stayed.
